docs.summary: The pipeline destination for a UI element. Mirrors [`RenderMode`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.UI.RenderMode) but lives on the render side, where it controls *where* the UI queue draws and *which* projection it uses. Kept separate from [`RenderMode`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.UI.RenderMode) so the pipeline never references user-facing component fields directly.
Drawn into the camera's color RT in the same pass as 3D Transparent geometry. Items participate in frustum culling and back-to-front sorting.
Drawn directly to the back-buffer (or camera target) after the final blit and gizmos. Bypasses HDR tonemapping and post-process.
